## Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Problem Statement

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**

A clear and concise description of what the problem is.

## Proposed Solution

**Describe the solution you'd like**

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Alternatives Considered

**Describe alternatives you've considered**

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Use Cases

**Who would benefit from this feature?**

- Use Case 1: [Describe a specific scenario where this feature would be helpful]

- Use Case 3: [...]

## Mockups / Examples (optional)

If you have mockups, screenshots, or examples from other applications that demonstrate this feature, please include them here.

```
Paste code examples or configuration examples here (if applicable)
```

## Technical Considerations (optional)

If you have technical knowledge, describe:

- Potential implementation approach
- Dependencies or libraries that might help
- Potential challenges or trade-offs

## Priority & Impact

**How important is this feature to you?**

- [ ] Critical - Blocking my usage of Savvy
- [ ] High - Would significantly improve my workflow
- [ ] Medium - Nice to have
- [ ] Low - Just an idea

**How many users would benefit?**

- [ ] All users
- [ ] Most users
- [ ] Some users
- [ ] Power users / advanced users
- [ ] Just me
